item.tib: rdo rje theg pa'i sbom po'i ltung ba
item.skt: badzra aY na s+thU la pat+ti
item.coloph: rdo rje theg pa'i sbom po'i ltung ba/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad+ma ka ra barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun paN+Di ta chen po ma Ni ka shrI dz+nyA na'i zhal snga nas dang / chag lo tsA ba shAkya'i dge slong chos rje dpal gyis zhus te dag par bgyis so
